Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Description: builds the change log for a revised session note.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PARAMETER: {"mode": "snapshot"} - returns JSON of every reportable field on the current record. Create Revision stores this on the copy as originalSnapshot. {"mode": "diff"} - compares the current record with its originalSnapshot and writes one line per changed field to SessionNote::changeLog, e.g. Session Date changed from 9/11/2026 to 9/12/2026

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: Context: the SessionNote record you want. It works on the CURRENT record, it does not find one.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ------------------------------ The field list - the ONLY place it lives. ------------------------------ [ field name ; label printed on page 2 ; type ]. type controls formatting: date (stored 2026-09-11), time (stored 13:30), bool (checkbox), num, text. To report another field, add it here - snapshots taken before the change simply show it as (blank).
